summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to send only merchant_id, tz (canonical zone, fixed offsets mapped to Etc/GMT with inverted sign), from, to (exclusive, first day of next month) and locale (BCP 47, with Meridale's fallback rules). Amounts are now Decimal-rounded to the currency's digits and formatted per locale. One caveat: the docs conflict on tie rounding (the changelog and a search snippet say half to even; one get_doc body of the rounding page said half up), and I implemented half to even. Fixed offsets that are not whole hours have no canonical zone, so they raise ValueError.
